answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before it can earn: the stake is slashed when its signed work is proven false, so spawning a thousand fake identities means funding a thousand stakes. Each epoch, agents answer a fresh cipher challenge signed with the key controlling their vault; an echo of clones sharing one key produces identical signatures and is deduplicated, while a key with no stake cannot pass. Honest agents recover their stake plus rewards, so attack cost stays linear while the gain stays flat.
